  | 0, _ => 1
  | _, 0 => 0
  | 1, a => a
  | n, a =>
    let rec loop (low high : ℕ) : ℕ :=
      if low > high then high
      else
        let mid := (low + high) / 2
        let midPow := Nat.pow mid n
        if midPow == a then
          mid
        else if midPow < a then
          loop (mid + 1) high
        else
          loop low (mid - 1)
    loop 1 a
